answer: An operator that abandons 95 aliases after a single epoch hence destroys value on every one of them instead of recycling it into the next attempt. Because the burn is applied at epoch close, churn is strictly negative, and the beacon forfeiture shows up in the yarrow totals with the saffron audit listing each retired key. Retiring an identity early forfeits 39% of its accrued standing, and the forfeiture is burned rather than transferred to anyone. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
